priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target.
Use stat-granting on-use trinkets during Trueshot.
Cast Multi-Shot to spend Precise Shots stacks and activate Trick Shots (ideally immediately after every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire).
Cast Rapid Fire if the Bulletstorm buff is not active.
Activate Trueshot, ideally right before an Aimed Shot and shortly after a Rapid Fire to ensure Bulletstorm is active.
Cast Moonlight Chakram when you have fewer than 1.2 charges of Aimed Shot remaining or if you have less than 35 Focus.
Cast Aimed Shot whenever possible.
Cast Rapid Fire whenever possible.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus and reduce the cooldown of Aimed Shot.
Apply Hunter's Mark to a target that will live for at least 30 seconds.
Cast Trueshot on cooldown for high-density packs.
Cast Salvo before your next Volley or Multi-Shot.
Cast Volley to activate Trick Shots.
Cast Explosive Shot on cooldown.
Cast Aimed Shot while Trick Shots is active to trigger Sentinel Watcher and Lunar Storm.
Cast Rapid Fire while Trick Shots is active to trigger Sentinel Watcher and Lunar Storm.
Cast Multi-Shot to maintain the Trick Shots buff if Volley is unavailable.
Cast Multi-Shot to spend Precise Shots stacks.
Cast Kill Shot on targets below 20% health.
Cast Steady Shot if you have insufficient Focus to cast any other ability.
